title: Serve European Flash and division tables from extracted data
changes: Publish all 536 authenticated Flash and signed division source bytes in e382-d381 and project the eight spans at their original bus addresses.
validation: Windows GNU sjbeggdr and Wine nf5isxeo PASS. One original in-memory Flash ID query, four selector cases, 12 timer rows, 3063 normalization cases and 12 signed divisions match with altered backing. Backup bytes, 768 boundary checks, complete state and clock, e381 attachment and two invalid attachment guards pass. The CLI creates, verifies and reuses 183 files and preserves 181 resources. All 17 guards and server drain pass. Stage izglzzpx retains e382.
limitations: The original routines run from controlled entries. Full startup, ordinary save and Load/Undo lifecycle, translated callers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
